caption:
You already pay someone to answer the phone.

That's the objection we hear most, and it's a fair one. A front desk can only do one thing at a time: talk to the caller in front of them.

Run this test this week. Have a friend or relative, not you, call your main line three times: during lunch, at 5:45pm, and in the middle of a busy afternoon. Write down who picks up, how long it rings, and whether it lands in voicemail.

One widely cited Harvard Business Review study found the average company takes 42 hours to respond to a new lead. A lot of that gap happens in the exact windows above, with a real person on staff the whole time.

Automation backs up your front desk. It catches the calls they can't physically take and texts the caller back in seconds, before they hang up and dial the next name on the list.

See it work on your own number.
